_doc: Register of SYNTHETIC gold fixtures — golds whose Input.Name names no printed Magic card. Verified 2026-07-20 (ADR-0004 issue #37) against the full Scryfall bulk (oracle-cards.json): 15 of 1,583 golds resolve in neither the corpus (card-inputs.json) nor the bulk, and for every one of them the SIBLING golds filed under the same set folder DO resolve — so the absence is not a stale-bulk or corpus-filter artifact, it is the fixture being invented. That makes each entry a fact about Magic (no card bears this name), i.e. Evidence, NOT a claim about parser/corpus coverage. GATE (GoldOracleTextFidelityTests, three directions, no suppression): a gold naming a card absent from BOTH sources must be registered here (else loud failure — a wrong gold parses green on pure self-consistency); a registered gold whose name later resolves in EITHER source must be removed (it now gets real oracle-text validation); and every entry must name a gold that still exists. Renamed from fidelity-uncovered-allowlist.json — the old name framed a verified Evidence register as coverage debt.
